verdict.rationale: Vanta documents in-product AI that works on the customer's compliance data. Per the vendor, Vanta AI reviews evidence, flags gaps, and suggests fixes, and the Vanta AI Agent flags issues and supports agentic search and questions across policies, controls, frameworks, tests, and documents. The MCP remediation-plan flow runs in external AI tools, not inside the product, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how in-app insights and suggestions are generated and shown, and independent or hands-on corroboration that they work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Vanta AI reviews evidence, flags gaps, and suggests fixes so you're ready faster with less manual work.
Vanta AI Agent, including agentic search and asking questions (across policies, controls, frameworks, tests, documents)
working tirelessly across the Vanta platform to draft policies, complete questionnaires, and flag issues before they escalate.
